The MAAWLR system is mounted on a pickup truck chassis and is equipped with an electro-optical targeting system for autonomous target detection, while also being capable of receiving external target designation from radar assets. Depending on the munition used, the system is assessed to be capable of engaging drones at ranges of approximately 6–15 km.

headline: The U.S. Senate voted 50-48 to pass a concurrent resolution to limit U.S. President Donald J. Trump’s ability to resume combat operations against Iran.
